intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for TelemetrySample. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Immutable record Telemetry Sample (one 1Hz data point): deviceId, metric, tDevice, tIngress, value, status. Invariants: all reference components non-null and deviceId non-blank (violations throw NullPointerException / IllegalArgumentException); the value is never altered or dropped, validation only replaces the status through withStatus. Record equality is by components.

methods.signature: TelemetrySample(String deviceId, MetricKind metric, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, double value, ValidationStatus status)
methods.semantics: Null rejected (NullPointerException); deviceId must be non-blank; a sample that has not been validated yet is built with ValidationStatus.UNVALIDATED (never null).
Device Timestamp, the only chronological ordering key; never null.
Arrival time at the engine, stored but never used for ordering; never null.
Raw payload value, kept verbatim even when invalid.
Never null; UNVALIDATED is the pre-validation encoding.
Returns a copy with only the status replaced; null status rejected.
